name: @pipeworx/mcp-makstat-mk

tools.name: subjects
tools.description: Browse the North Macedonia State Statistical Office (MakStat) PxWeb subject tree under the /MakStat database. Empty path returns top-level folders (type 'l'); drill with sub-paths to reach tables (type 't', '.px' suffix). Returns folder/table list for the given path.

path.description: Sub-path under /MakStat/ (default empty = root, returns top-level folders).

tools.name: table_meta
tools.description: Fetch dimension definitions and valid coded values for a MakStat PxWeb table. Path must end in the '.px' table id (e.g. 'Naselenie/VencaniRazvedeni/280_VitStat_Brak_voz_ml.px'). Returns dimensions with their codes and value lists — use these to build the selection body for query_table.

tools.name: query_table
tools.description: POST a PxWeb query to a MakStat (North Macedonia statistics) table and return observations as json-stat2. body must be {query:[{code, selection:{filter,values}}], response:{format:'json-stat2'}}. PxWeb enforces a cell-count limit — narrow each dimension's values using codes from table_meta to avoid rejection.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-makstat-mk forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the makstat-mk pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
